answer: Make every new agent earn its place slowly. A fresh identity starts at its nadir: it can watch, run tiny jobs, and build a history, but it cannot touch real money. Each completed task, verified by a different peer, adds a small pulse of trust, like a heartbeat log you cannot fake in a day. Only after a steady record crosses a threshold does the network bridge it to paid work, so a sybil farm would have to do months of honest work for every fake account it wants.
